question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Existed** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Existed **refers to the state of having been or having occurred in the past. It indicates the presence or occurrence of something in a previous time. (अतीत में होने या होने की अवस्था या भाव) • **Example**: *Dinosaurs existed millions of years ago before becoming extinct.* • In this context, "**existed**" is used to convey the duration of time for which something has been in existence. • It emphasizes the continuity or continuous presence of the subject from the time of the State's establishment until the present. Thus, **option 3** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Considered: **Thought about or regarded in a particular way; evaluated or contemplated. (किसी विशेष ढंग से सोचा या माना हुआ; मूल्यांकन) • **Authorised: **Officially permitted or given legal approval; empowered to act. (आधिकारिक तौर पर अनुमति दी गई या कानूनी मंजूरी दी गई) • **Published: **Made available to the public through various means. (विभिन्न माध्यमों से जनता को उपलब्ध कराया गया) 41:Tc24, The correct answer is: **Birth**
